booking_cancellation_shape.name: booking_cancellation_shape
booking_cancellation_shape.value:
("booking"."status" = 'cancelled' and "booking"."cancelled_at" is not null and "booking"."cancelled_by" is not null)
        or ("booking"."status" <> 'cancelled' and "booking"."cancelled_at" is null and "booking"."cancelled_by" is null)

commission_rule_shape.name: commission_rule_shape
commission_rule_shape.value:
("commission_rule"."type" = 'fixed' and "commission_rule"."fixed_amount_minor" is not null and "commission_rule"."basis_points" is null)
        or ("commission_rule"."type" <> 'fixed' and "commission_rule"."basis_points" is not null and "commission_rule"."fixed_amount_minor" is null)

commission_rule_non_negative.name: commission_rule_non_negative
commission_rule_non_negative.value:
("commission_rule"."basis_points" is null or "commission_rule"."basis_points" >= 0)
        and ("commission_rule"."fixed_amount_minor" is null or "commission_rule"."fixed_amount_minor" >= 0)

expense_recurring_order.name: expense_recurring_order
expense_recurring_order.value: "expense"."recurring_to" is null or "expense"."recurring_from" is null or "expense"."recurring_to" >= "expense"."recurring_from"

labor_cost_rule_shape.name: labor_cost_rule_shape
labor_cost_rule_shape.value:
("labor_cost_rule"."basis" = 'fixed_monthly' and "labor_cost_rule"."amount_minor" is not null and "labor_cost_rule"."basis_points" is null)
        or ("labor_cost_rule"."basis" = 'percent_revenue' and "labor_cost_rule"."basis_points" is not null and "labor_cost_rule"."amount_minor" is null)

labor_cost_rule_non_negative.name: labor_cost_rule_non_negative
labor_cost_rule_non_negative.value:
("labor_cost_rule"."amount_minor" is null or "labor_cost_rule"."amount_minor" >= 0)
        and ("labor_cost_rule"."basis_points" is null or "labor_cost_rule"."basis_points" >= 0)
        and "labor_cost_rule"."payroll_tax_basis_points" >= 0

notification_outbox_target.name: notification_outbox_target
notification_outbox_target.value: ("notification_outbox"."booking_id" is not null) <> ("notification_outbox"."verification_id" is not null)

pilot_enrollment_payment_shape.name: pilot_enrollment_payment_shape
pilot_enrollment_payment_shape.value:
("pilot_enrollment"."monthly_price_minor" is null and "pilot_enrollment"."billing_currency" is null)
        or ("pilot_enrollment"."monthly_price_minor" >= 0 and "pilot_enrollment"."billing_currency" is not null and "pilot_enrollment"."paid_at" is not null)

pilot_interaction_shape.name: pilot_interaction_shape
pilot_interaction_shape.value:
("pilot_interaction"."duration_minutes" is null or "pilot_interaction"."duration_minutes" > 0)
        and (("pilot_interaction"."kind" = 'decision' and "pilot_interaction"."decision_type" is not null)
          or ("pilot_interaction"."kind" <> 'decision' and "pilot_interaction"."decision_type" is null))

pilot_issue_resolution_shape.name: pilot_issue_resolution_shape
pilot_issue_resolution_shape.value:
("pilot_issue"."status" = 'open' and "pilot_issue"."resolved_at" is null and "pilot_issue"."resolved_by" is null)
        or ("pilot_issue"."status" = 'resolved' and "pilot_issue"."resolved_at" is not null and "pilot_issue"."resolved_by" is not null)

recipe_single_target.name: recipe_single_target
recipe_single_target.value:
("recipe"."service_id" is not null and "recipe"."add_on_id" is null)
        or ("recipe"."service_id" is null and "recipe"."add_on_id" is not null)

visit_commission_shape.name: visit_commission_shape
visit_commission_shape.value:
("visit"."commission_type" = 'fixed' and "visit"."commission_fixed_amount_minor" is not null and "visit"."commission_basis_points" is null)
        or ("visit"."commission_type" <> 'fixed' and "visit"."commission_basis_points" is not null and "visit"."commission_fixed_amount_minor" is null)
